newsitem.title: USA: Accelr8 to offer 1.15 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Accelr8 to offer 1.15 mln shares.

text.p: Accelr8 Technology Corp said on Tuesday it had filed for a public offering of 1.15 million shares at an anticipated price of $5.50 to $6.50 each.
One million shares will be offered by the company and 150,000 will be offered by shareholders, the company said.
The anticipated price per share would follow a proposed reverse stock split, Accelr8 said. The split will range from one-for-five to one-for-seven, it said.
